Remaining useful life estimated at 106.6 cycles, policy band above_50_monitor, indicating no imminent failure but monitoring required.
Similar unit U041 experienced bearing wear symptoms with vibration increase and required bearing replacement (ticket T1040).
SOP states bearing wear is indicated by increased spindle vibration without load increase and normal coolant parameters.
Recommended immediate action is to reduce spindle speed and schedule bearing replacement within 48 hours.

report.summary: Unit U021 at cycle 109 triggered an anomaly (score 0.657) driven by a 13% rise in spindle vibration (z=2.3) while load and outlet pressure fell modestly. These patterns match bearing wear signatures: elevated vibration without load increase and stable coolant metrics. Similar bearing wear cases in fleet (ticket T1040) and SOP-M-101 guidance support this diagnosis. RUL remains >50 cycles, so immediate shutdown is not required, but bearing replacement should be scheduled promptly per SOP.
